AOI defect handling

Sample lab note for retrieval practice. Not a factory instruction, and not an extract from a standard.

AOI defect handling > Open

1. Locate the sample open flag on the net note.
2. Check that the lead is sitting off the sample pad.
3. Move the board to the sample touch-up tray.

AOI defect handling > Short

1. Find the sample short between the two named nets.
2. Look for a solder bridge on the sample photo note.
3. Stop the board and call the sample rework step.

AOI defect handling > Mousebite

1. Match the sample mousebite mark to the board edge.
2. Leave the edge alone in this sample flow.
3. Record the sample board id and set the board aside.

AOI defect handling > Spur

1. Find the sample spur on the trace.
2. Confirm it is extra copper and not a stain on the sample photo.
3. Route the board to the sample review bin.

AOI defect handling > Copper

Copper here means spurious copper. This sample uses that name the same way the AOI class list does.

1. Mark the sample copper flag on the lot sheet.
2. Compare the pad with the sample reference note.
3. Leave the copper in place for the sample review.

AOI defect handling > Pin-hole

1. Find the sample pin-hole in the pad fill.
2. Note the sample pad id on the practice sheet.
3. Send the board on to the sample rework SOP.

Reflow soldering SOP

Sample lab SOP for retrieval practice. Not a factory profile, and the zones below have no real degrees or seconds.

Reflow soldering SOP > Purpose

This sample walks a board through a pretend reflow oven. Read it as practice text.

Reflow soldering SOP > Paste

1. Align the sample stencil to the board fiducials.
2. Make one sample print and look at the pads.
3. Wipe the stencil when the sample print smears.

Reflow soldering SOP > Profile

The sample profile has a preheat zone, a soak zone, and a peak zone. This fixture does not list a temperature or a time. Leave the oven controls alone.

Reflow soldering SOP > Cooling

Let the sample board exit onto the sample rack. Wait until the practice note says the board is safe to hold.

Touch-up sample

Sample bench note for retrieval practice. Not a work instruction.

Touch-up sample > Iron

1. Pick up the sample iron only after the stand is clear.
2. Tin the sample tip on the dummy pad.
3. Put the iron back on the stand between joints.

Touch-up sample > After

Write the sample board id on the lot card. Leave the pass box empty in this exercise.

波峰焊 SOP

样例文件，只给检索练习用，不是产线作业指导。

波峰焊 SOP > 1. 目的

本样例描述实验台上的波峰焊顺序。里面的温度和速度都是编出来的，不能拿去设定设备。

波峰焊 SOP > 2. 准备

1. 核对样例工单上的助焊剂名称。
2. 看预热区的样例显示是否亮着。
3. 把轨道宽度调到样例板的宽度。
4. 确认锡槽盖已经合上。

波峰焊 SOP > 4.3 温度

锡温在本样例里只是一个假窗口。链速跟着样例板走，不做真实工艺判定。

波峰焊 SOP > 5. 样例点检

下面每条都是虚构点检。句子故意写得接近，方便对照这一节被切开以后，同一条会同时出现在相邻的两块里。不要拿去设定设备。

第01条样例点检只给检索练习用，主题是锡槽显示。记录员把一个虚构现象写进练习单，注明这不是工艺限度。这个读数不能拿去调整预热、链速、助焊剂、轨道或锡槽。看板上的样例标记即可，不要对照厂内窗口，也不要抄进正式记录。

波峰焊 SOP > 6. 出板

目视之前先看这一节。下一小节才是动作，这里不写判定。

波峰焊 SOP > 6. 出板 > 6.1 目视

1. 把样例板放到架子上。
2. 看板面有没有明显的样例桥连。
3. 在练习单上写下样例板号，不要写合格。
